crossrefs.text: The LORD did not set His affection on you and choose you because you were more numerous than the other peoples, for you were the fewest of all peoples.
But because the LORD loved you and kept the oath He swore to your fathers, He brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you from the house of slavery, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
With God we will perform with valor, and He will trample our enemies.
You might say in your heart, “The power and strength of my hands have made this wealth for me.”
But remember that it is the LORD your God who gives you the power to gain wealth, in order to confirm His covenant that He swore to your fathers even to this day.
With God we will perform with valor, and He will trample our enemies.
All the nations surrounded me, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
I was pushed so hard I was falling, but the LORD helped me.
Have You not rejected us, O God? Will You no longer march out, O God, with our armies?
Why have You rejected us forever, O God? Why does Your anger smolder against the sheep of Your pasture?
I will make them a horror and an offense to all the kingdoms of the earth, a disgrace and an object of scorn, ridicule, and cursing wherever I have banished them.
You have rejected us, O God; You have broken us; You have been angry; restore us!
Have You not rejected us, O God? Will You no longer march out, O God, with our armies?
And I will set My face against you, so that you will be defeated by your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you, and you will flee when no one pursues you.
Then the LORD will scatter you among the peoples, and only a few of you will survive among the nations to which the LORD will drive you.
O Lord, what can I say, now that Israel has turned its back and run from its enemies?
As it is written: “For Your sake we face death all day long; we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered.”
I, the LORD, search the heart; I examine the mind to reward a man according to his way, by what his deeds deserve.
“Can a man hide in secret places where I cannot see him?” declares the LORD. “Do I not fill the heavens and the earth?” declares the LORD.
He was oppressed and afflicted, yet He did not open His mouth. He was led like a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is silent, so He did not open His mouth.
Does He not see my ways and count my every step?
For His eyes are on the ways of a man, and He sees his every step.
There is no darkness or deep shadow where the workers of iniquity can hide.
The arrogant utterly deride me, but I do not turn from Your law.

notes.title: We are regarded as sheep to be slaughtered

crossrefs.text: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, for with the LORD is loving devotion, and with Him is redemption in abundance.
And He will redeem Israel from all iniquity.
Redeem Israel, O God, from all its distress.
My soul cleaves to the dust; revive me according to Your word.
Why do You hide Your face and consider me as Your enemy?
But I will walk with integrity; redeem me and be merciful to me.
Take up Your shield and buckler; arise and come to my aid.

After a long time, the king of Egypt died. The Israelites groaned and cried out under their burden of slavery, and their cry for deliverance from bondage ascended to God. So God heard their groaning, and He remembered His covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
